name: LaunchDarkly API
tagline: Feature flags and progressive delivery control plane
description: LaunchDarkly is a feature management platform with a REST API for managing flags, environments, segments, and experiments. Developers use it to automate flag lifecycle, sync configuration, and integrate progressive delivery into CI/CD and ops tooling.

auth.details: API access token via Authorization: YOUR_API_KEY header (or Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY). Create personal or service tokens in Account settings; project-scoped tokens available.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown — free Developer plan exists but API call quotas not published on public pricing page
pricing.paid_plans: Foundation, Enterprise, and Guardian plans; contact sales for API-specific entitlements

rate_limits: not published on public docs as of research date
use_cases: list projects and environments in a LaunchDarkly account
create or update a feature flag for an environment
toggle a flag on or off for progressive rollout
list flag configurations and targeting rules
manage segments used for audience targeting
